Searches for GST/tender/contract evidence returned no results (search backend unavailable: 'searx: Connection refused'), and no public domestic-supply record was located. GSTIN and turnover: null (not public in retrieved sources).
note: Company exists and is active in customs data, but only as an IMPORTER/consignee of auto accessories, auto lamps, CNC router and enameling machine (Oct-Nov 2022, HS 870006/840405/850053 as recorded by the source) — these are inbound logistics records, not evidence of the company's own export shipments. No export bill of lading, no destination country, no export HS code attributable to this company was found; therefore export_status = none_found, not 'declared_only'. Declared HS 841989;848180 (petrochem/chemical equipment) is NOT corroborated by any shipment record seen — the observed HS codes relate to auto parts and machinery, and the observed trade flow is import, not export. Per project rules this HS mismatch is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base with the HS code to be corrected to the factual one. Role appears to be freight forwarder / logistics agent (address: 323, Plot No.9, Vikas Surya Galaxy, Sector-4 Central Market, Dwarka, New Delhi - 110075), i.e. a trader/service intermediary, not a manufacturer. No traces of supply (neither export nor domestic) attributable to this company as a seller were found. Revenue and export volume: null — not public. Caveats: volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403; importkey India page for the exact legal-name slug was an empty paywalled shell; DuckDuckGo search backend was down for all queries, so absence of evidence is partly a tooling limitation and should be re-checked when search is restored.
